pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Hybrid melee/thrown weapon. Attack speed 1.6. Melee attacks are guaranteed critical hits (jump-crit sound & particles).

• Melee damage: 10 (netherite-axe tier). Can strip logs.
• Guaranteed melee crit: final damage ×1.5 (single multiplier, no stacking).
• Thrown: hold right-click to charge, release to throw. Base damage 10 on hit. Retrievable.
• 80% dodge chance while held (main or offhand).
• Executes mobs below 30% HP.

Repair: gold ingots.

The doll can wield this axe in melee or throw it, and a thrown axe also executes at 30% HP. While a doll wields it, the execute threshold takes the higher of the two values (25% base / 30% axe = 30%).
